sections.content: You know *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27 and necessity + subjunctive from B1 Unit 35. Here you use *es necesario que*, *es importante que* and *hace falta que* to say what has to change, and the infinitive when no particular person is named.

items.spanish: Es necesario que la sociedad se adapte.
items.english: It is necessary for society to adapt.

items.spanish: Es importante que mejoremos la educación.
items.english: It is important that we improve education.

items.spanish: Hace falta que cambien algunas cosas.

items.english: It is necessary to improve the system.

sections.content: Compare: Es necesario mejorar el sistema (no person named, infinitive) and Es necesario que la sociedad se adapte (a person named, subjunctive).
